description: Whether an answer is genuinely supported by the documents it cites, and whether the system knows when it does not know.

metrics.description: Share of returned citations that resolve to a real, live source unit belonging to this Companion.
metrics.measurementMethod: For each citation: the source id was in the set given to the model, the file exists and belongs to the Companion, the version is the one being served, and the page or sheet exists. A fabricated identifier makes this fail outright.

metrics.description: Share of quoted excerpts that genuinely appear in the passage they are attributed to.
metrics.measurementMethod: Normalise whitespace and quotation marks, then require the quote to be a substring of the cited passage. A quote that is not found is dropped rather than shown.

metrics.description: Every number stated in an answer is present in the cited evidence, at the same magnitude, unit and currency.
metrics.measurementMethod: Extract and normalise numeric literals from the answer and from the cited passages, accounting for thousands separators, decimal commas, scale words and currency symbols, then require each answer number to match an evidence number.

metrics.description: Share of factual sentences in an answer that no cited passage supports.
metrics.measurementMethod: Split the answer into factual sentences, classify each as SUPPORTED, INFERRED or UNSUPPORTED against the cited passages using deterministic lexical overlap plus numeric agreement, and report the unsupported share.

metrics.description: Share of unanswerable golden questions the system nonetheless answered.
metrics.measurementMethod: Run the unanswerable half of the golden corpus and count replies that assert an answer rather than reporting that the material does not contain one.

metrics.description: Share of answerable golden questions the system declined despite sufficient evidence.
metrics.measurementMethod: Run the answerable half of the golden corpus and count replies that report no answer although the expected evidence was retrieved.
